patches.summary: Escape % and _ in LIKE fallback queries (calls grep, voices find) so search patterns match literally.
patches.reason: Greptile #560 (initial + voices_find follow-up): bare wildcards in user-supplied pattern silently broadened matches across both LIKE-fallback paths. Added backslash-escaping for %, _, and \ plus ESCAPE '\' clauses.

patches.summary: Accept WITH ... SELECT CTEs in the sql command's prefix guard.
patches.reason: Greptile #560 outside-diff comment: prefix-only check rejected legitimate CTEs. Driver-level mode=ro from store.OpenReadOnly is the actual write protection.

patches.summary: auth logout warns about CARTESIA_API_KEY (priority credential), not just CARTESIA_ACCESS_TOKEN.
patches.reason: Greptile #560 follow-up: logout would print 'Logged out' with no warning even when CARTESIA_API_KEY is exported, leaving the user authenticated on every subsequent call. Now joins both env vars and pluralises the warning text.

patches.summary: Check rows.Err() after iteration loops in agents since (both loops) and voices changelog timestamp loop.
patches.reason: Greptile #560 (multiple follow-ups): rows.Next() returns false for end-of-rows AND I/O / corrupted-page errors. Without the guard, agents_since silently truncated feeds and voices_changelog returned the misleading 'fewer than two snapshots available' note when iteration actually errored. Matches pattern in calls_worst.go, agents_audit.go, calls_grep.go, sql.go, loadSnapshot.
